title: Pip and the Fallen Star
logline: A little fox finds a fallen star in the ferns and, with a wise old owl and the fireflies of Willow Wood, wishes it home.

style.suffix: 3D animated family movie style, cute stylized characters with expressive faces, soft cinematic lighting, rich warm colors, detailed storybook forest, smooth high quality animation

pip.name: Pip
pip.look: a small red fox cub with big amber eyes, a fluffy white-tipped tail and a little green scarf

ollo.name: Ollo
ollo.look: a wise old grey owl with round golden spectacles and fluffy silver feathers

lumi.name: Lumi
lumi.look: a tiny glowing golden star creature with five soft rounded points and a sweet little face

shots.title: Pip and the Fallen Star
shots.scene: a cozy moonlit forest at the edge of a calm river, tall willow trees, fireflies drifting
shots.action: the fox cub sits on a mossy rock by the river gazing up at the starry sky, slow camera push in

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: At the edge of Willow Wood, where the river hums at night, lived a little fox named Pip.

shots.scene: the night sky above a dark forest, a bright falling star streaking down into the ferns
shots.action: a glowing star falls from the sky trailing golden sparks, the fox cub's ears perk up in surprise

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: One evening, something strange happened. A light tumbled from the sky... and landed in the ferns.

shots.scene: a moonlit forest clearing with glowing ferns in the distance
shots.action: the fox cub jumps up excitedly and points a paw toward the glowing ferns, talking with wide happy eyes

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: Whoa! Did you see that? A real shooting star, right here in our wood!

shots.scene: dark tall ferns glowing softly from within, moonlight, mist
shots.action: the fox cub tiptoes carefully through the tall ferns and slowly pushes the leaves aside, curious and cautious

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Pip crept closer. Deep in the ferns, something tiny was glowing... and sniffling.

shots.scene: inside a nest of green ferns at night, soft golden glow
shots.action: the tiny star creature sits curled up with tears in its eyes, flickering dimly, talking softly

lines.speaker: lumi
lines.text: Please don't hurt me. I fell... and now I can't get home.

shots.scene: green ferns at night lit by warm golden light
shots.action: the fox cub lies down gently and smiles kindly at the tiny star creature, talking softly

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: Hurt you? Never! I'm Pip. What's your name?

shots.scene: green ferns at night lit by warm golden light
shots.action: the tiny star creature looks up shyly and glows a little brighter, talking

lines.speaker: lumi
lines.text: I'm Lumi. Every night I shine above the river. But tonight... I slipped.
lines.tts: I'm Loomee. Every night I shine above the river. But tonight... I slipped.

shots.action: the fox cub stands up proudly with a determined smile while the tiny star creature sits on its head, talking

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: Then we'll get you back home. And I know exactly who can help!

shots.scene: a moonlit forest path winding up a hill to a huge ancient oak tree
shots.action: the fox cub runs along the path carrying the glowing star creature toward the giant oak tree, camera tracking alongside

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Pip carried Lumi through the wood, to the oldest oak, where Ollo the owl kept watch.
lines.tts: Pip carried Loomee through the wood, to the oldest oak, where Ollo the owl kept watch.

shots.scene: a cozy hollow in a giant old oak tree, moonlight and a small lantern glowing
shots.action: the old owl leans forward, adjusts its spectacles with a wing and blinks slowly, talking

lines.speaker: ollo
lines.text: Well now... a fallen star. That hasn't happened in a hundred years.

shots.scene: a branch of a giant old oak tree under a sky full of stars
shots.action: the old owl spreads one wing toward the sky while speaking, the fox cub and the glowing star creature listen closely

lines.speaker: ollo
lines.text: Stars rise on wishes, little one. The more hearts that wish... the higher they fly.

shots.scene: under a giant oak tree at night, dark forest all around
shots.action: the fox cub looks down worriedly at the glowing star creature in its paws, ears drooping, talking quietly

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: But it's only us. Is two enough?

shots.scene: a vast dark forest at night seen from a hilltop
shots.action: hundreds of fireflies light up one by one across the dark forest while the fox cub looks around in amazement

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Just then, one by one, the fireflies of Willow Wood began to glow.

shots.scene: a hilltop clearing full of swirling glowing fireflies under the stars
shots.action: the fox cub raises the glowing star creature high above its head and shouts joyfully, fireflies swirling around them

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: Everyone! Wish with us! Wish Lumi home!
lines.tts: Everyone! Wish with us! Wish Loomee home!

shots.scene: a hilltop under a starry night sky, fireflies everywhere
shots.action: the tiny star creature glows brighter and brighter and floats up into the night sky leaving a golden trail, the fox cub watches from below

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Lumi glowed brighter... and brighter... and rose up, into the night sky.
lines.tts: Loomee glowed brighter... and brighter... and rose up, into the night sky.

shots.scene: the starry night sky high above a river
shots.action: the tiny star creature waves happily from high in the sky, sparkling, talking

lines.speaker: lumi
lines.text: Thank you, Pip! Look for me above the river!

shots.scene: a calm river reflecting a starry sky, willow trees
shots.action: the fox cub sits by the river smiling up at one star that twinkles brighter than all the others, slow camera pull out

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And every night since, the brightest star over Willow Wood twinkles... just for Pip.

metadata.title: Pip and the Fallen Star | A Bedtime Story (AI animated)
metadata.summary: A little fox finds a fallen star in the ferns. With the help of Ollo the owl and the fireflies of Willow Wood, Pip wishes Lumi back into the sky.
